facts.text: I am choosing to go ahead with GMI's program.
I am the director of human resources and in charge of DEI initiatives in an ad agency with several offices across India.
I am facing a rising attrition rate in my company.
The quality of managers in my company has been less than satisfactory.
My company is not going ahead with the GMI plan.
I am tasked with coming with four alternative modules for managerial leadership development programs.
We can start with a First-time Manager program.
The cohort coming for the First-time Manager program are not good managers.
The core of the First-time Manager program is basic teaching about how to become a decent manager.
The first point is about an advanced Managerial skills program.
The cohort coming for the advanced Managerial skills program are not good managers.
The core of the advanced Managerial skills program is basic teaching about how to become a decent manager.
